Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq reports network disruption, US equities data feeds impacted
Markets.summary: Nasdaq experienced a network disruption at its Carteret facility due to a technical issue, causing data gaps in US equities markets. The exchange advised clients to switch to backup feeds from Chicago and submit recovery requests for missing information.

Markets.title: S&P 500’s road to 8,000 grows tougher as yields rise, AI doubts mount; all eyes on quarterly earnings
Markets.summary: Analysts doubt the S&P 500 will reach 8,000 points because rising oil prices, higher bond yields, and midterm election uncertainty are increasing market risks. Additionally, mixed financial results from major technology companies and a growing divide between large and small corporations are raising doubts about artificial intelligence investments.

Markets.title: Sebi writes to IRDAI to include investors' insurance policy details in consolidated account statement
Markets.summary: Markets regulator Sebi has asked the insurance regulator to include investors' insurance policy details in the Consolidated Account Statement. This initiative aims to give investors a comprehensive financial overview of their investments, with similar integration of bank deposits also underway.

Markets.title: IIFL Finance Q2 profit nearly doubles to Rs 805 crore; AUM rises 38%
Markets.summary: IIFL Finance reported that its Q2 profit nearly doubled to Rs 805 crore due to stronger operating leverage and lower loan losses. Assets under management grew 38% to Rs 1.24 lakh crore, driven primarily by an increase in gold loans.

Markets.title: L&T Finance Q2 net profit rises 33% to Rs 975 crore
Markets.summary: L&T Finance reported a 33% increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 975 crore for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company's consolidated loan book grew 28% year-on-year to Rs 1.36 lakh crore while asset quality improved.

Markets.title: Sebi revises CAS rules, changes derivatives expiry settlement methodology
Markets.summary: Sebi has revised the closing auction session for the equity cash market to run from 3:30 pm to 3:40 pm starting in December 2026. The regulator has also updated the methodology for calculating derivatives contract settlement prices while establishing new rules for unexecuted orders.

Geo-Political.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
Geo-Political.summary: Former President Trump canceled the planned livestream of Nidal Hasan's execution by firing squad. Hasan, the Fort Hood attacker, faces the first U.S. military execution in over 60 years.

Geo-Political.title: Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking oil refinery after Zelensky says strikes to resume
Geo-Political.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery following new Russian strikes. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that a previous pause on targeting energy sites is now over.

Geo-Political.title: At least 33 pupils and teacher killed after school roof collapses in Pakistan
Geo-Political.summary: A school roof collapse in Pakistan killed at least 33 pupils and a teacher after crashing through three classrooms. Children were buried under the debris, according to police.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead in Istanbul after heaviest rainfall in 84 years, governor says
Geo-Political.summary: Two people died in Istanbul during the heaviest rainfall recorded in 84 years. Officials advised residents to stay home unless leaving is strictly necessary.

Geo-Political.title: Seven crew missing after drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania's coast
Geo-Political.summary: A drone attack in the Black Sea set a tanker ablaze off the coast of Romania. A search and rescue operation is currently underway for seven missing crew members.

Geo-Political.title: White House defends new press secretary over her legal credentials
Geo-Political.summary: The White House is defending its new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, following questions about her legal background. Reports indicate that Zacharia is not registered to practice law in any state where she has previously lived.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An experiment showed that an author's WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without any paid advertising. This discovery highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This article outlines the top ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s new forex reserve rules explained: FAQs on the 20% requirement, $2 million threshold and exemptions
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has clarified its 20% foreign exchange risk reserve requirement for rupee-linked currency derivatives. The new guidance details specific rules regarding the $2 million threshold, exemptions, cancellations, and rollovers.

Data & Insights.title: US wholesale inflation hits four-year high of 6.3% in September as gas prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: US wholesale inflation rose to a four-year high of 6.3% in September. This acceleration was driven primarily by a sharp surge in gasoline prices.

Data & Insights.title: Unemployment rate rises in urban areas in September
Data & Insights.summary: Urban unemployment increased in September. However, overall joblessness remained steady because rural unemployment stayed stable.

Data & Insights.title: Net direct tax collections up 13.2% at  ₹13.38 tn, corporate tax buoys
Data & Insights.summary: India's net direct tax collections increased by 13.2% to ₹13.38 trillion. This growth was primarily driven by strong corporate tax receipts amid improving economic prospects.

Data & Insights.title: IMF backs India's revised GDP methodology, projects it to overtake Japan as 4th-largest economy in 2027
Data & Insights.summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has validated India's revised GDP methodology and raised its 2026 growth forecast to 7 percent. Based on these projections, India is expected to surpass Japan with a nominal GDP of $4.52 trillion, becoming the world's fourth-largest economy in 2027.

Data & Insights.title: India's merchandise trade deficit widens to $30.21 billion in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to $30.21 billion in September as imports grew faster than exports. During the month, exports rose to $44.40 billion while imports increased to $74.61 billion.

India.title: In Delhi Murder Caught On CCTV, Police Flag 'Tihar Jail Rivalry', Arrest 4 Men
India.summary: Delhi police arrested four men for the murder of Shahid Hussain, whose killing was captured on CCTV. Investigators believe the attack stemmed from a rivalry that began in Tihar Jail, where the Jamia Nagar resident had been held before his release earlier in the week.

India.title: Tension In Assam's Jorhat Over Blinkit Employees' Pro-CJP Slogans
India.summary: Blinkit employees in Jorhat, Assam, raised pro-CJP slogans, triggering a tense confrontation in the area. Jorhat Police rushed to the scene to manage the situation.

India.title: '15% Cut, Billions In Contracts': Opposition Alleges Corruption In Telangana Road Projects
India.summary: The opposition in Telangana has alleged corruption involving billions in road contracts and a 15% cut. This controversy follows claims by a company's managing director questioning the bid evaluation process for Hyderabad's Radial Road-2.

India.title: Unable To Control Pests, Telangana Farmer Sets Paddy Crop On Fire
India.summary: A Telangana farmer set his paddy crop on fire after failing to control a severe pest infestation. He stated that the infestation worsened due to state-imposed power cuts that disrupted farming operations.

General.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
General.summary: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson was sentenced to 15 years in prison for historical child sex abuse. He was convicted of 18 offenses, including one count of rape, committed against two female victims.

General.title: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
General.summary: President Trump canceled plans to livestream the execution of Fort Hood attacker Nidal Hasan by firing squad. Hasan's execution will mark the first military execution in over 60 years.

General.title: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
General.summary: NHS England has issued new guidance stating that transgender patients should be cared for in hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex. This policy applies to single-sex hospital spaces across the healthcare system.

General.title: Russell Brand accuser says he turned 'monster-like' before alleged rape
General.summary: An accuser of Russell Brand stated that he became "monster-like" prior to an alleged rape. Brand currently faces three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault, and one charge of indecent assault.

General.title: Severe drought declared in parts of southern England
General.summary: Severe drought has been declared in parts of southern England due to reservoir levels continuing to drop. This water shortage is a result of a hot summer and below-average rainfall in September.

General.title: Meghan makes first official public appearance since moving back to UK
General.summary: Meghan made her first official public appearance since moving back to the UK. She and the Duke of Sussex are attending a series of charitable events in Nottingham.
